decisions.thought: Opponent has Gholdengo, Rotom-Wash, Annihilape, Dragapult, Garchomp, Kingambit. Bring Gholdengo (Good as Gold blocks status, beats their Gholdengo), Kingambit (dark STAB vs Gholdengo/Annihilape), Garchomp (rocks + EQ). Primarina/Glimmora sit out. Watch for Rotom-Wash levitate and Annihilape rage fist.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Bring Gholdengo, Garchomp, Primarina? Kingambit good vs Gholdengo. Bring Gholdengo, Kingambit, Garchomp.

decisions.thought: Lead Garchomp (Mega). Gholdengo Scarf cleans and threatens Primarina/Glimmora/Dragapult. Kingambit is the late-game sweeper with Sucker Punch. Watch out for their Primarina, which beats Chomp and Dragons. Watch out for Glimmora's Toxic Debris. Record what each of their Pokémon is carrying.

Lead Gholdengo vs opp Garchomp. Make It Rain lands hard (Steel hits Garchomp neutrally, Dragon/Ground weak elsewhere); 149 speed likely outruns. Life Orb boost. Watch for Rough Skin contact — keep Gholdengo special-based. Plan: punish Garchomp now, keep Garchomp for rocks/EQ vs Rotom-Wash, Kingambit vs their Gholdengo/Kingambit.

Turn 1: Mega Chomp EQ on their Gholdengo. Watch whether it outspeeds (Scarf). Kingambit late-game sweeper with Sucker Punch. Dangers: Primarina (Water/Fairy) beats Chomp; Dragapult may be fast. My Scarf Gholdengo handles Primarina/Glimmora/Dragapult. Record their items and moves.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Mega Garchomp trades speed for a big attack boost, dropping from 102 to 92 base speed, though it should still outspeed Gholdengo barring a scarf. Earthquake hits Gholdengo super effectively, and with the Mega's attack jumping from 130 to 170 base, this should deal massive damage—likely close to an OHKO on anything not exceptionally bulky. Going with Mega Earthquake.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo died turn 1 to Mega Garchomp EQ. Send my Garchomp: immune to EQ, faster (169 vs ≤158), can EQ back hard and set rocks. Their Garchomp is Sand Force, likely holding Garchompite. Keep Kingambit for their Gholdengo/Kingambit/Annihilape. Watch Dragapult speed later.

Gholdengo died turn 1 to Mega Garchomp EQ. My Garchomp outspeeds (169 vs ≤158) and is EQ-immune. EQ now — likely OHKO or close. Then set rocks vs next mon. Keep Kingambit healthy for their Gholdengo/Kingambit/Annihilape. Watch Dragapult speed (up to 213, outspeeds me).
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Mega Garchomp EQ vs my Garchomp: immune. I'm faster, EQ does big damage. Mega Garchomp ~244 max Atk; my EQ 182 Atk vs 103-161 Def — likely OHKO or near. EQ is best.

decisions.thought: T2: Dragon Claw their Garchomp (expected OHKO vs low HP). Watch whether it outspeeds (169 max, Scarf?) and whether it has Rough Skin. 1 unknown left: dragapult/kingambit/primarina/glimmora. Scarf Gholdengo checks Primarina/Glimmora/Dragapult. Kingambit is the late Sucker Punch cleaner.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I'm checking if their Garchomp could be running Scarf given its speed outpaces mine, then calculating Mega Garchomp's Dragon Claw damage against likely Garchomp bulk spreads, working through the defense stat at level 50.

Running the numbers, Dragon Claw lands around 178-210 damage, which is a likely OHKO against uninvested HP Garchomp but not guaranteed against bulkier spreads. I also check whether their Garchomp outspeeding me and hitting back with Dragon Claw would threaten me first, but my defense holds up enough to survive even a Choice Band hit, so attacking with Dragon Claw is the right call.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo dead turn 1 to Mega Garchomp EQ. My Garchomp at 7.7% won't survive; EQ won't KO from 42%. Switch Kingambit: resists Dragon Claw, tanks EQ, threatens with Sucker Punch/Kowtow. Keep Garchomp as a pivot/sac for rocks later. Their Garchomp is Sand Force with Garchompite, already mega. Watch for Dragapult/Kingambit/Gholdengo/Rotom/Annihilape coming in.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp at 7.7%, EQ kills? Opp at 42%, EQ did 12% per hit... wait turn 2 EQ took 54→42? That's only 12%? Odd—maybe Sand Force... Actually EQ did 12%? That seems low. Hmm, maybe rough skin numbers confused. Anyway EQ again likely won't KO. Garchomp at 14 HP will die to anything. Better: EQ to chip, or switch Kingambit to save Garchomp? Kingambit resists Dragon Claw, immune to EQ? No, Kingambit takes neutral EQ. Switching preserves Garchomp; Kingambit can Sucker Punch. But Garchomp nearly dead anyway; EQ then let it die? EQ at 42% won't KO. Switch Kingambit, save Garchomp as sac later? Kingambit takes Dragon Claw fine, EQ neutral. Switch.

decisions.thought: T3: Their Garchomp (Rough Skin, Leftovers, EQ, faster than 158) is at 7%. I EQ it, since EQ makes no contact and avoids Rough Skin. If my Chomp falls, bring in Kingambit and Sucker Punch to finish it with the Supreme Overlord boost. Scarf Gholdengo handles Primarina/Glimmora/Dragapult. 1 unknown left in their team.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Their Garchomp at 7% is faster than us and threatens another Earthquake that would finish us off. I'm weighing whether Kingambit or Gholdengo can handle it, but both are weak to Ground, so switching in is risky—Kingambit's Sucker Punch could pick it off with priority if it attacks, but I need to time the switch carefully.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Only Garchomp left at 7.7%; Kingambit and Gholdengo dead. Opposing Mega Garchomp at 42%. EQ only chips ~12%, so try Scaleshot: super effective, 2-5 hits, might KO before I die. Rough Skin chips them on contact too. If I survive, keep pivoting; expect Dragapult/Kingambit/Gholdengo/Rotom/Annihilape as their remaining picks.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp at 7.7% will die anyway. EQ from 42% won't KO (needs ~2.4 hits). Scaleshot super effective might do decent damage but risky. Best: EQ to chip, or just sac. Actually EQ at 182 Atk vs 42% — turn 2 EQ did 12% (54→42). So EQ won't KO. Scaleshot 2-5 hits, 25 BP each SE... roughly 25*2*1.5=75 BP per hit, could do ~30-60%. Might KO with 4-5 hits. Worth trying scaleshot? Risk: they EQ first? No, I'm faster. Scaleshot likely best chance to KO.

decisions.thought: T4: Their last mon is Garchomp at 7% (Rough Skin, Leftovers, EQ, faster than 158). I EQ it. If my Chomp faints, send in Kingambit and Sucker Punch. If they Swords Dance instead of attacking, Sucker Punch fails, so use Kowtow Cleave or Iron Head instead.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Their Garchomp at 7% HP outspeeds me and could finish me off with another Earthquake since I'm at 78 HP. Switching to Gholdengo exposes it to a 4x weak EQ, which is bad, but Kingambit can tank the Earthquake with its 207 HP and threaten back with Sucker Punch.

Switching Kingambit in now would eat the EQ for moderate damage and let sucker punch clean up after. Either path works, but attacking directly also leaves a chance their move misses for a clean KO, so I'll go with EQ.

decisions.thought: T4 switch: Kingambit in vs their last mon, Garchomp at 13% (+1 Spe, -1 Def, Rough Skin, Leftovers, EQ and Scale Shot). Use Sucker Punch to finish it. If they Swords Dance or don't attack, Sucker Punch fails, so then use Kowtow Cleave. Scarf Gholdengo is slower than their +1 Garchomp, so keep it out.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
At +1 speed, their Garchomp likely outpaces a Scarf Gholdengo, and an Earthquake would hit Gholdengo hard given its weaker defense compared to Mega Garchomp's — roughly 197 damage by my estimate, which is a serious threat.

Kingambit looks safer here: it survives a doubled Earthquake comfortably under 207, and Sucker Punch gets a Supreme Overlord boost from my one fainted ally, enough to take down a 13% target even without priority risk from a potential Swords Dance. I'll go with Kingambit.

decisions.thought: Only Garchomp left at 13.7%; Gholdengo and Kingambit dead. Kingambit is full HP with Supreme Overlord boost. I'll EQ (super effective) before dying; Kingambit likely Sucker Punches me first. Their last pick is from dragapult/gholdengo/rotomwash/annihilape. Nothing to save for—just deal damage.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp at 13.7% vs Kingambit. EQ is super effective but Kingambit resists... no, Kingambit is Dark/Steel, EQ super effective (2x). Kingambit at full HP with Supreme Overlord. Garchomp at 25 HP will likely die to Kingambit's Sucker Punch or any hit. EQ does decent damage; Kingambit may Sucker Punch (priority). Garchomp dies anyway; best to EQ for damage before dying? Kingambit likely KOs Garchomp. EQ is best value.

decisions.thought: T5: Their last mon is Garchomp at 13% (+1 Spe, -1 Def, Rough Skin, Leftovers, EQ and Scale Shot). Kingambit at full HP should survive one EQ, so Kowtow Cleave finishes it even after a Swords Dance. If Kingambit falls, Scarf Gholdengo uses Make It Rain to finish.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Their Garchomp is at 13% and their last mon, so Sucker Punch kills if it moves to attack. I'm checking whether Kingambit survives an Earthquake from Garchomp given the super-effective Ground-type matchup against Dark/Steel, estimating around 165 damage against Kingambit's bulk.

Weighing risk: Sucker Punch wins outright if they attack, but fails against Swords Dance setup, letting a boosted EQ kill me before I act. Kowtow Cleave is safer since it always kills after absorbing one hit, with the only real risk being a crit EQ at roughly 4%, so I'm leaning toward Kowtow Cleave over Sucker Punch despite the contact/Rough Skin being irrelevant here.
